svg.title: One block. Three ways through it.

cc:Work.dc:title: One block. Three ways through it.
cc:Work.dc:description: One four-layer block illustrated on a curved surface. A standard ViT uses four distinct layers for four steps. Raptor, based on the Block Recurrent Hypothesis, uses one shared layer four times to approximate the intermediate steps. TWT uses one learned layer once to approximate the block endpoint. The surface and trajectories are conceptual.
